# churn-forge

> The sovereign pattern forge run on a REAL company dataset: 7,043 real telecom customers
> (IBM Telco Customer Churn, frozen + sha256-sealed). It keeps only churn patterns that
> predict held-out customers it never saw, reports honestly where breeding does NOT help,
> and mints the winner as a tiny owned model. The re-runnable alternative to RAG-on-your-CSV.

## What it proves (sealed in predictions.json before measurement)
- A churn pattern GENERALISES on held-out real customers: held-out balanced accuracy 0.726 (coin-flip = 0.5).
- The strongest driver is a real, nameable one: a month-to-month contract.
- 4 patterns clear the held-out bar on customers the forge never saw.
- HONEST: breeding compound rules did NOT beat the single best pattern here — reported, not overclaimed.
- The classifier mints as a 20-byte OWNED model (certified beats chance); owning beats renting an LLM (OWN_WINS).

## Proof-of-play
- load.mjs is mutation-witnessed (score 1.0) and fuzzed never-throw.
- data/telco-churn.csv is frozen and sha256-sealed; CI verifies the exact bytes each run.
- ci-verify.mjs re-derives every sealed fact from the real data on GitHub's runner; the live page runs the identical kernels and self-checks the same claims.
- Forge/breed/mint kernels vendored + pinned from pattern-forge and fallforgemint (see VENDOR.md).
